column1: # qxf_map.tsv - QLC+ fixture file + mode -> LJ4EVR profile id (design 6.1 item 1, ME-8, ME-26). Hand-maintained.
# Columns: file (third_party/qlcplus-fixtures/)  mode (the <Mode Name>)  id (exe row 0-200, or an extra >= 1000, append-only).
# An exe id with a hand file (tier 1) keeps the hand profile; the conversion exists only so tools/qxf2c.py --selftest can show
# "hand wins" (id 12). Modes with more than 32 channels cannot be mapped (LJ_PROFILE_CH). Matching = exe triple vs QLC+ mode by
# channel count and the Martin mode name; rows LJ2 names but QLC+ lacks (812 Mode 2, Roboscan 1220, MAC 550/575/1200, MAC 2000
# mk I, Mania, CX-10) stay greyed; extras are QLC+ fixtures LJ2 never had, hidden unless [FIXTURES] ShowExtraProfiles=1.
